claims.claim: Israel's standard VAT rate is 18%, in effect since 01.01.2025 (raised from 17%) and held through 2026. Example: net 15,000 NIS x 18% = 2,700 NIS VAT, total 17,700 NIS.
claims.raw_snippet: סכום המע"מ מחושב בשיעור קבוע ממחיר העסקה או הסחורה, והחל מיום 01.01.2025 הוא עומד על 18% ממחיר הרכישה או השירות (לפני כן, עד 31.12.2024, השיעור היה 17%).
claims.verification_note: gov.il returns HTTP 403 to scripted fetches; the 18% rate (in force since 1.1.2025, unchanged for 2026) was confirmed by reading the Tax Authority's rate page in a browser.

claims.claim: Allocation-number net thresholds (before VAT): May 2024 > 25,000 NIS (25,000 ש"ח); Jan 2025 > 20,000 NIS (20,000 ש"ח); Jan 2026 > 10,000 NIS (10,000 ש"ח); from June 1 2026 > 5,000 NIS (5,000 ש"ח).
claims.raw_snippet: בשלב הראשון עמד הסכום על 25,000 ₪, והחל מה-1 ביוני 2026 הסכום ירד ועומד על 5,000 ₪. מאי 2024: 25,000 ₪. ינואר 2025: 20,000 ₪. ינואר 2026: 10,000 ש"ח. יוני 2026 ואילך: 5,000 ש"ח.
claims.verification_note: gov.il returns HTTP 403 to scripted fetches. The page was rendered in a browser and the threshold schedule read from the live DOM on 2026-07-26.

claims.claim: From June 1, 2026 the obligation to obtain an allocation number for a tax invoice expands to transactions exceeding 5,000 NIS (5,000 ש"ח) before VAT; this step-down is in effect, accelerated from the originally scheduled 2028 date.
claims.raw_snippet: החל מיום 1.6.2026 תורחב החובה לקבל מספר הקצאה לחשבונית מס, כך שתחול על עסקאות שסכומן עולה על 5,000 ש"ח (לפני מע"מ).

claims.claim: VAT Law section 47(a2)(1) (סעיף 47(א2)(1) לחוק מע"מ): an osek murshe must request an allocation number at the buyer's demand for a transaction whose amount before VAT exceeds the section 38(a1) threshold (סעיף 38(א1)), and the subsection does not apply to a zero-rated transaction
claims.raw_snippet: ובעסקה שסכומה, בלא המס, עולה על הסכום האמור בסעיף 38(א1), חייב הוא לעשות כן לפי דרישת הקונה

claims.claim: An Israeli TIN / mispar osek is a 9-digit number validated with a Luhn-style check digit: the weighted digit sum is valid when sum modulo 10 == 0.
claims.raw_snippet: Most credit card numbers and many government identification numbers use the algorithm as a simple method of distinguishing valid numbers from mistyped or otherwise incorrect numbers
claims.verification_note: Same page lists "Israeli ID numbers" among the systems that use it.

claims.claim: On refusal the requester is offered four alternatives: cancel the request; continue without an allocation number; continue and offer the buyer a reverse charge, available only where the buyer is a registered osek murshe; or apply to the control unit and set a hearing. The reverse-charge route requires cancelling the refused invoice and issuing a new one with identical details except a zero VAT value and a different reference number, which receives a special allocation number and is reported as a zero-rated transaction.
claims.raw_snippet: בפני מבקש ההקצאה יוצגו לבחירה 4 החלופות הבאות: 1. ביטול הבקשה למספר הקצאה. 2. המשך העסקה ללא קבלת מספר הקצאה. 3. המשך העסקה - הצעה לקונה לקבל על עצמו את תשלום המס ("היפוך חיוב")
claims.verification_note: gov.il returns HTTP 403 to scripted fetches; rendered in a browser and read from the live DOM on 2026-07-26.

claims.claim: Emergency allocation numbers are intended solely for a technological failure of the Tax Authority's own systems, not for a local communication fault. On a local failure the issuer has three options: request the number through the standalone application; wait, within the period the law allows (up to 14 days from the tax point), until the fault is fixed and only then issue the invoice; or issue the invoice without a number and request one retroactively once the fault is fixed.
claims.raw_snippet: בכל מקרה של כשל "מקומי" - עומדות לרשות מוציא החשבונית 3 חלופות
claims.verification_note: gov.il returns HTTP 403 to scripted fetches; rendered in a browser and read from the live DOM on 2026-07-26.

claims.claim: An invoice dated after 4.5.2024 that requires an allocation number and does not carry one is disallowed as an input, and the input is automatically reduced from the inputs included in the detailed report. Deducting input VAT on the basis of a tax invoice with no allocation number is an offence under the VAT Law.
claims.raw_snippet: ניכוי מס תשומות על סמך חשבונית מס ללא מספר הקצאה הינו עבירה על חוק מע"מ

claims.claim: In the reverse-charge alternative the supplier issues the customer an invoice with VAT at a rate of zero that DOES include an allocation number, and the customer issues a self-invoice and reports the allocation number from that zero invoice in the detailed report. An ordinary self-invoice unrelated to the new law needs no allocation number.

claims.claim: Tax Authority API spec v2.0, section 1.2 (סעיף 1.2 במפרט; ובחוק סעיף 47(א2)(1)): The allocation-number duty applies only when four conditions all hold: amount before VAT above the threshold, a non-zero VAT component, the customer is a licensed dealer (osek murshe), and the customer requested a number; a number may be requested for any amount and customer, including credits
claims.raw_snippet: The invoice includes a non-zero VAT component. The customer is a "licensed dealer". The customer has requested an allocation number. However, an allocation number for each invoice may be requested, for any amount and for each customer including credits.
claims.verification_note: ITA API Description v2.0 (7.2024), section 1.2, extracted with pdftotext. The same list opens 'The disclosure obligation applies when four of the following conditions are met'. Its year table (15,000 for 2026 etc.) is the ORIGINAL schedule, superseded by the accelerated one; only the four conditions are relied on. Corroborated in Hebrew by Grant Thornton Israel (25.5.2026): 'חשבוניות בשיעור אפס או חשבוניות הכוללות רק עסקאות פטורות אינן טעונות מספר הקצאה'.

claims.claim: Refusal hearing timetable under VAT Law section 47(a2)(3)(b) and 47(a4) (סעיף 47(א4)): hearing within 2 business days of the online notice; a decision not given within 1 business day of the hearing counts as approval; objection within 30 days of the hearing; the director decides within 21 business days or the objection counts as accepted; appeal to the District Court
claims.raw_snippet: המנהל יחליט בהשגה בתוך 21 ימי עסקים מיום הגשתה

claims.claim: VAT Law section 38(a1): input tax on a tax invoice whose amount before VAT exceeds NIS 5,000 and which carries no number allocated by the director may not be deducted
claims.raw_snippet: לא יותר ניכוי מס התשומות הכלול בחשבונית מס שסכומה, בלא המס, עולה על 5,000 שקלים חדשים ושאינה כוללת מספר שהקצה לה המנהל

claims.claim: Section 47(a2) applies only to a tax invoice for a transaction that is not zero-rated

claims.claim: A number may be requested after the invoice is issued (סעיף 47(א2)(4)), but that does not change the section 38(a) deadline (סעיף 38(א)) to deduct input VAT within six months of the invoice date

claims.claim: Under section 47(a3) (סעיף 47(א3)) the buyer who takes on the tax issues a tax invoice in its own name bearing the allocated number and reports the transaction, and the supplier issues a zero-rate invoice stating it was issued under that subsection
